extracted.intended_audience: content creators and educators producing educational videos (YouTube creators, teachers making explainer content)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for producing engaging educational video content (especially math) that attracts and retains a broad audience by using storytelling, approachable teaching, and strong visuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open with a compelling hook (mystery/challenge/discovery)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each video opens with a hook that feels like a mystery, a challenge, or a fascinating discovery instead of diving straight into equations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples given: “What’s the most controversial number in mathematics?”, “Can you really prove that 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + … = -1/12?”, “Why does an infinite hotel always have room for one more guest?”; guidance: start with what makes the topic compelling and leave technical details for later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Frame content as a story, not a lecture
rubrics_metrics.description: The video isn’t about math as raw equations; it’s about the story behind the math. The equations become part of the journey, not the focus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the audience follow a narrative or puzzle—present discovery and context before technical exposition so viewers are engaged by the arc, not just facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature enthusiastic, clear teachers/experts
rubrics_metrics.description: Presenters should be genuinely excited about the topic; Numberphile’s stars (e.g., Dr. Hannah Fry, James Grime) speak with enthusiasm, clarity, and a touch of humor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recruit or encourage experts who are excited and can communicate without sounding lecturing; enthusiasm is infectious and shapes audience engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid condescension and overwhelming jargon
rubrics_metrics.description: There’s no condescension, no overwhelming jargon, and no sense that the viewer is being lectured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use plain language where possible; explain necessary terms gently; anti-patterns include talking down to viewers or piling on technical terms without context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a conversational tone and step-by-step pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Numberphile uses a conversational tone, excellent visuals, and a step-by-step approach so explanations never rush and each concept builds naturally on the last.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pacing should guide viewers to the ‘big idea’ gradually so the final concept feels effortless; avoid moving too fast or skipping foundational steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make understanding the presenter’s responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: If your audience doesn’t understand something, it’s (usually) never their fault, it’s yours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design explanations, examples, and visuals to bridge gaps; test for clarity and assume you must break down the idea further rather than blaming the audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use visuals to make abstract ideas visible
rubrics_metrics.description: Every video makes sure the math is something you can see and follow, not just hear—e.g., scribbled notes on brown paper or real-time animations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ sketches, animations, and real-time drawing to illustrate steps and relationships; visuals should directly support the explanation and reduce cognitive load.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tap into curiosity rather than dumbing down
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand your audience by framing content to tap into curiosity; you don’t need to “dumb down” content—make it feel like an adventure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame niche topics as puzzles, mysteries, or riddles that anyone can enjoy; emphasize wonder and discovery over simplification that removes substance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain high energy and fascination
rubrics_metrics.description: Every video starts from a place of fascination; keep the energy high so people care because you care first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present with visible curiosity and excitement; aim to make complexity feel effortless through tone and delivery so viewers stay engaged.
